page.Per chi gestisce da sé il proprio appart: For those who run their own apartment, B&B or holiday home. Pick only the services you need, when you need them: no management contract, you only pay for what you use.
page.Pacchetti pronti di lenzuola e asciugama: Ready-made packs of sheets and towels, washed and ironed. Pick them up at the B&B Point and bring them back once used. Deposit required.
page.Lasci le chiavi da noi, i tuoi ospiti le: Leave your keys with us and your guests collect them at the info point. Every handover is recorded in the key register.
page.Pulizia completa al cambio ospiti, con p: Full changeover cleaning between guests, at a fixed price based on the type of apartment. By appointment.
page.Comunicazione alloggiati alla Questura,: Guest registration with the police (Questura), tourist tax, ISTAT statistics and CIN: we handle it all, per booking or with a monthly subscription.
page.Con la gestione completa facciamo tutto: With full management we do everything: listings, bookings, guests, cleaning and paperwork. You only pay on bookings.
page.<b>Ci lasci le chiavi.</b> Le consegni a: You leave us the keys. Drop them at the info point with the guest's name and arrival date. You sign the key register and the keys are tagged with a code (never with the address).
page.<b>L'ospite le ritira.</b> In orario d'u: The guest collects them. During office hours, showing an ID document. We record name, ID, date and time in the register and the guest signs.
page.<b>Riconsegna.</b> Alla partenza l'ospit: Return. On departure the guest brings the keys back to us; the register entry is closed and we let you know on WhatsApp.
page.<b>Fuori orario?</b> Su appuntamento o c: Outside office hours? By appointment or via a key safe, for a surcharge.
page.<b>Prenoti i pacchetti.</b> Ci scrivi qu: Book your packs. Tell us how many people are arriving and when: one pack per person (sheets, pillowcase, towels).
page.<b>Lasci la cauzione.</b> Al primo ritir: Leave a deposit. On your first pick-up you pay a linen deposit, recorded in the register.
page.<b>Ritiri e riporti.</b> Ritiri i pacche: Pick up and return. Collect clean packs and bring back the used ones, even at the same time as you pick up new ones.
page.<b>Cauzione restituita.</b> Quando ricon: Deposit refunded. When you return all the linen, your deposit is refunded. Missing or damaged items are deducted from it.
page.Prezzi IVA inclusa. Pulizie a prezzo fis: Prices include VAT. Cleaning at a fixed price based on the type of home.
page.Consegna chiavi · fuori orario, su appun: Key handover · outside office hours, by appointment

page.Prenotando qui pago di meno?: Do I pay less if I book here?
page.Sì. Prenotando online sul nostro sito ha: Yes. Booking online on our website gets you 10% off compared with OTA prices (Booking.com, Airbnb and the other portals); booking by phone or WhatsApp gets you 5% off OTA prices. Price and terms are always shown before you confirm.
page.Sì: per i soggiorni fino al 30 giugno 20: Yes: for stays until 30 June 2027 parking is free, while spaces last. When you book, we'll tell you whether it's available for your dates.
page.Come funziona il Riviera Rent Club?: How does the Riviera Rent Club work?
page.È gratis: ad ogni soggiorno prenotato di: It's free: every stay you book direct with us earns you points (1 point for every € 10). With 100 points you get € 50 off your next holiday, or perks such as early check-in or late check-out.
page.Cosa vuol dire che siete associati a Fin: What does being members of Finale Enduro mean?
page.Collaboriamo con Finale Enduro: chi vien: We work with Finale Enduro: riders get dedicated perks, access to the Finale Enduro card network and homes equipped for bikers. Ask at our office for details.
page.Dove ritiro le chiavi?: Where do I pick up the keys?
page.All'info point (indirizzo nei contatti),: At the info point (address under Contact), open every day 9:00–12:30 and 15:00–18:00, or directly at the property.
page.Quanto costa la gestione per i proprieta: How much does management cost for owners?
page.Lavoriamo a commissione solo sulle preno: We work on commission, only on confirmed bookings. The percentage depends on the property and the services, and we give it to you in writing after our visit.
page.È il nostro servizio per chi affitta da: It's our service for people who let on their own: linen hire, key handover with a register, cleaning and, as a separate service, paperwork. You choose what to use, with no management contract.
page.Come funziona la cauzione della biancher: How does the linen deposit work?
page.Al primo ritiro lasci una cauzione, anno: On your first pick-up you leave a deposit, recorded in the register. It's refunded when you return all the linen; any missing or damaged items are deducted.
page.In quali zone gestite le case?: Which areas do you manage homes in?
page.In tutta la Liguria, costa ed entroterra: All across Liguria, on the coast and inland.
